text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A truly breathtaking run—it was Narita 
Brian who conquered the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel admired that figure all the 
more, wishing fervently in her heart to 
surpass her one day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, that would be for when she could 
run at full power. For the sake of that 
day, she managed to hold back and conserve 
her strength in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel wishes for Narita Brian to 
become even stronger. Strong enough that 
no one could ever beat her in the Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because a chance to defeat Narita Brian 
would open up for her too. Sakura Laurel 
begins taking straight strides toward the 
one she admires.
